## Checklist

- [ ] OpenAPI regenerated and committed (if API changed)
- [ ] Migration reversible and documented (if schema changed)

- [ ] No secrets, no model identity in commits or comments
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under Unreleased
- [ ] BACKLOG.md updated for anything deferred or proposed
- [ ] Security review record attached (if touching auth, outbound HTTP, files, templates, email, printing, admin)
- [ ] Accessibility checks run (if UI changed)
